description: This file defines the 'Framework' class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the Symfony HttpKernel class for handling HTTP requests, setting up dependency injection, routing, logging, and plugin initialization for the application's core framework components.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Main application kernel extending Symfony's HttpKernel, responsible for configuring services, routing, logging, plugins, and handling requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Framework with environment and debug settings, and configures container and logger.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Sets up dependency injection container with core services like request stack, dispatcher, resolver, Doctrine ORM, and authentication chain.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging service and attaches a LoggerSubscriber to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Configures routing components, URL generator, URL helper, and attaches route event listeners.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming HTTP request, setting up routing and plugins before delegating to parent handler.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
